discription: A plucked string-like sound using the Karplus-Strong synthesis algorithm, capable of producing metallic or woody string tones.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, sustain=0.5, pluckDecay=0.8; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.1, sustain, 0.2, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Pluck.ar(in: Impulse.ar(0, 0, 1), trigger: 1, maxdelaytime: 0.1, delaytime: 1.0/freq, decay: pluckDecay, coef: 0.5); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
